attributes.board_name: Michigan Board of Dentistry (LARA Bureau of Professional Licensing)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved CE under R 338.11704a (incl. volunteer patient/supportive dental services within limits)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Hours apply to licensees licensed for the whole 3-year period before expiration.
rules.alternatives: Waiver request under MCL 333.16205 at least 30 days before the last regular Board meeting before expiration.
rules.audit_note: Renewal application certifies compliance; keep evidence 5 years; Board may require proof.

topics.who: Dental ethics and jurisprudence incl. delegation of duties to allied dental personnel
Incl. handpiece sterilization, PPE and CDC guidelines
All licensees: 1 hour per year of the license cycle (R 338.7004); does not count toward CE hours
One-time training in identifying victims of human trafficking (R 338.11271)
Controlled substance licensees: opioids and controlled substances awareness training (R 338.3135)
Current BLS or ACLS with hands-on component

rules.notes: 3-year cycle. At least 20 h clinical issues and at least 20 h live/synchronous; max 30 h asynchronous. Current BLS or ACLS with hands-on component required. Dental specialists: 20 of the 60 h in the specialty. Fee $296.40 (+$248.10 controlled substance license).
rules.rule_quote: (2) An applicant for a dentist license renewal who has been licensed for the 3-year period immediately preceding the expiration date of the license shall complete not less than 60 hours of continuing education approved by the board under R 338.11704a during the 3- year period before the end of the license cycle.
